headline: XP Investimentos Shifts to Defensive Portfolio, Adding JBS and WEG
summary: XP Investimentos updated its Top Actions portfolio for November by adding JBS, WEG, and Caixa Seguridade, increasing exposure to Rede D'Or, and reducing cyclical domestic exposure.
why: Brokerage portfolio rebalancing signals institutional shifts in sector preferences and risk appetite amid changing macroeconomic conditions.

impacts.name: JBS SA
impacts.why: Inclusion in a prominent brokerage's recommended portfolio can drive institutional inflows.
